class.name: ParticipantWindow
class.brief_description: A [Window] for one of several players running in the same process.
class.description: Each player gets their own window, world and input. Add it to a [ParticipantViewport] to show it. It starts hidden. [codeblock] var slot := ParticipantWindow.new() slot.own_world_3d = true slot.world_3d = World3D.new() slot.username = &"player_two" add_child(slot) tiler.add_slot(slot) tiler.assign_device(1, slot) [/codeblock] The [code]stretch_[/code] members work like those of [ParticipantView], using the project's [code]display/window/stretch/*[/code] settings by default.

method.name: send_input
method.description: Sends [param event] to this window at the end of the frame. Use it for input the window does not receive by focus, such as a joypad.

method.name: set_tiled_rect
method.description: Moves and resizes this window to [param rect], and shows it. [ParticipantViewport] calls it.

members.member: The [MultiplayerTree] of the player in this window, or [code]null[/code].
The peer id of the player in this window, or [code]0[/code] before they join.
Sets [member Window.content_scale_size]. [code]Vector2i(0, 0)[/code] uses the project's viewport size.
Sets [member Window.content_scale_factor]. [code]0.0[/code] or less uses the project setting.
The username of the player in this window.
